title: Get the result of a creative pre-review task
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the result of a pre-review task for creatives. # Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/pre_review/task/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/marketing-api-authentication/v1.3). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |task_id {Required}|string|The ID of the pre-review task.

To create a pre-review task and obtain the task ID, use any of the following endpoints:
  • [/creative/pre_review/task/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-creative-pre-review-task/v1.3)
  • [/file/video/ad/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-a-video/v1.3)
  • [/file/image/ad/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-an-image-reference/v1.3)

Note: If the `task_id` doesn't match the `advertiser_id`, an error will occur.| ``` ## Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/creative/pre_review/task/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&task_id={{task_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` # Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|task_status|string|The status of the pre-review task.

Enum values:

  • `PROCESSING`: The task is being processed.
  • `SUCCESS`: The task has been completed.
| #|pre_review_result_list|object[]|The list of results for the pre-reviews of the creatives.| ##|pre_review_status|string|The result of the pre-review for the creative.

Enum values:
  • `APPROVED`: Approved by the pre-review.
  • `REJECTED`: Rejected during pre-review.
  • `UNSURE`: Result cannot be determined.
  • `UNAVAILABLE`: Result unavailable.
| ##|material_type|string|The material type of the creative.

Enum values:
  • `VIDEO`: video.
  • `IMAGE`: image.
  • `AD_TEXT`: ad text.
  • `LANDING_PAGE_URL`: landing page URL.
| ##|material_id|string|The ID or content of the creative.
  • When `material_type` is `VIDEO`, this field represents the video ID of the video.
  • When `material_type` is `IMAGE`, this field represents the image ID of the image.
  • When `material_type` is `AD_TEXT`, this field represents the ad text.
  • When `material_type` is `LANDING_PAGE_URL`, this field represents the landing page URL.
| ##|result_creation_time|string|The time when the pre-review result was generated, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0).

Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`.| ##|result_expiration_time|string|The time when the pre-review result will expire, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0).

Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`.

Each pre-review result is valid for 180 days.| ##|location_code|string|The code of the location to target.

For enum values, see [List of values for `location_codes` or `location_code`](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-result-of-a-creative-pre-review-task/v1.3#anchor-2-1).

Example: `US`.| ##|is_ecommerce|boolean|Whether the creatives will be used in E-commerce ads including [GMV Max Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-gmv-max-campaigns/v1.3) and Catalog Ads.

Supported values: `true`, `false`.| ##|reject_info_list|object[]|The list of reasons for the rejection of the creatives.| ###|reason|string|The specific reason provided for the rejection of the creative.| ###|suggestion|string|The suggestion for resolving the rejection issues.| ``` ## List of values for `location_codes` or `location_code` The following table lists the enum values for the
